title: REVISED RULES AND REGULATIONS ON THE ESTABLISHMENT, SUPERVISION, OPERATION AND CONTROL OF CUSTOMS BONDED WAREHOUSES (CBWs)
subject: Pagtatayo, supervision, operasyon at kontrol ng Customs Bonded Warehouses (CBWs)
effectivity: Fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation

ai.title: CMO 03-2022 Overview
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ito ang bagong patakaran ng Bureau of Customs sa pagtatayo, pagpapatakbo, pag-supervise at pagkontrol ng Customs Bonded Warehouses (CBWs): mga bodega kung saan puwedeng ilagay ang imported na raw materials nang hindi muna binabayaran ang duties and taxes, basta gagamitin sa paggawa ng produktong ie-export.

🔍 Breakdown: Sec. 1 Objectives; Sec. 2 Administrative Provisions (storage, allowable imports, withdrawals, CCBW rules); Sec. 3 Application for Authority to Operate; Sec. 4 Renewal; Sec. 5 Appeal; Sec. 6 Certificate of Authority; Sec. 7 Warehouse Number; Sec. 8 Post-Approval Requirements; Sec. 9 Structural Changes, Extension Warehouse, Relocation; Sec. 10 Goods Declaration; Sec. 11 Withdrawal; Sec. 12 Direct Export; Sec. 13 Indirect Export; Sec. 14 Wastages; Sec. 15 Liquidation; Sec. 16 Abandonment; Sec. 17 Temporary Cessation; Sec. 18 Suspension at Closure; Sec. 19 Inspection; Sec. 20 PCAG Audit; Sec. 21 Monitoring; Sec. 22-23 Repealing at Effectivity; Annexes A hanggang N (forms).

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parang 'tax-free storage' ang CBW para sa manufacturer-exporter. Kapalit nito, mahigpit ang bantay ng BOC: may customs personnel, bond, logbook, at liquidation ng bawat import.

📦 Halimbawa: Nag-import ang garment exporter ng tela gamit ang WSAD. Inilagay sa CBW ang tela, ginawang damit, ini-export, tapos nilikida ang WSAD para ma-cancel ang bond.

⭐ Bakit Mahalaga Ito? Ito ang pangunahing rulebook ng bonded warehousing, kaya kailangan ito ng brokers, operators at customs personnel.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Maraming deadlines at porsyento (one-year storage, 30% local sales limit, 3-year validity). Huwag paghalu-haluin ang CCBW, ICBW, MCBW at PCBW.

🎯 Board Exam Tip: I-memorize ang storage period, local sales limit, validity ng Authority to Operate at ang renewal window (120 hanggang 91 araw).

❓ Madalas Malito ang Students: Puwede bang mag-import ng finished goods sa CBW? Sa pangkalahatan, hindi, maliban kung gagamitin itong component ng ibang finished goods na ie-export at aprubado ng CBWC.

🔗 Related Topics: CMTA Title VIII (Warehousing), CAO No. 01-2022, CMO No. 20-2021 (AIMS), CMO No. 04-2020 (E-TRACC).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Revised Rules on the Establishment, Supervision, Operation and Control of CBWs. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: SUBJECT: REVISED RULES AND REGULATIONS ON THE ESTABLISHMENT, SUPERVISION, OPERATION AND CONTROL OF CUSTOMS BONDED WAREHOUSES (CBWs)

ai.title: Subject ng Order
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sinasabi ng subject ang saklaw: pagtatayo, supervision, operasyon at kontrol ng CBWs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 'Revised' ito, kaya pinalitan nito ang lumang rules (tingnan ang Repealing Clause).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Introduction (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Subject ng Order. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide the procedures for the establishment of Customs Bonded Warehouses (CBWs) and the operations thereof.

ai.title: Objective: Procedures sa CBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Layunin ng Order na ilatag ang proseso ng pagtatayo ng CBW at ng operasyon nito.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dito nakasaad ang 'paano mag-apply at paano mag-operate', mula application hanggang closure.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi lang pagtatayo ang saklaw. Kasama rin ang araw-araw na operations.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 1.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Objective: Procedures sa CBW. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To establish, develop and implement a CBW management system making full use of information and communications technology (ICT) and more transparent procedures which would aid the Bureau of Customs (BOC) in the monitoring, supervision and control of CBW operations.

ai.title: Objective: ICT-based Management
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Gusto ng BOC ng CBW management system na gumagamit ng ICT at mas transparent na proseso para sa monitoring, supervision at control.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mas digital at mas madaling bantayan, hindi puro manual.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kaugnay ito ng ABMS, AIMS at E-TRACC na babanggitin sa mga susunod na sections.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 1.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Objective: ICT-based Management. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To institute a full compliance regime for operators on CBW operations and provide sanctions for violations thereof.

ai.title: Objective: Compliance at Sanctions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Layunin nitong magtakda ng buong compliance regime para sa CBW operators, kasama ang parusa sa paglabag.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May rules at may kaakibat na sanctions, gaya ng suspension at closure (Sec. 18).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 1.3 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Objective: Compliance at Sanctions. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: To provide for the duties, responsibilities and accountabilities of BOC personnel assigned to CBWs and CBW Operators including their accredited members, Client End-Users or Client-Exporters.

ai.title: Objective: Duties at Accountabilities
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Nakasaad dito ang duties at accountabilities ng BOC personnel sa CBW at ng CBW Operators, pati accredited members, Client End-Users at Client-Exporters.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dalawang panig ang may responsibilidad: ang BOC at ang private operators at partners nila.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang Annex 'E' para sa duties ng customs personnel.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 1.4 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Objective: Duties at Accountabilities. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: General Considerations.

ai.title: General Considerations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ito para sa pangkalahatang rules na sakop ang lahat ng CBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Basic rules muna (transfer, storage, allowable imports, withdrawals) bago ang special rules para sa CCBW sa Sec. 2.2.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa General Considerations. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transfers of Goods to CBWs. Goods for transfer to CBWs shall be subject to a mandatory non-intrusive inspection at the port of discharge whether covered by a Goods Declaration for Warehousing (WSAD) or Goods Declaration for Transit (TSAD). Unless the goods entered for warehousing is placed under Alert Order or selected for physical or non-intrusive examination, the District Collector shall allow the immediate transfer of bonded goods to the CBW where the 100% physical examination shall be conducted.

ai.title: Transfers of Goods to CBWs
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bago ilipat sa CBW, dadaan muna ang goods sa mandatory non-intrusive inspection sa port of discharge, WSAD man o TSAD ang gamit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Karaniwan, agad ililipat ang goods sa CBW at doon gagawin ang 100% physical examination. Pero kung may Alert Order o napili sa physical/non-intrusive exam, hindi agad papayagan ang transfer.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang 'Unless' ang susi: hindi awtomatiko ang immediate transfer.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Transfers of Goods to CBWs. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Storage Period of Bonded Goods. Goods entered for warehousing may remain in a CBW for a maximum period of one (1) year from the time of its arrival at the warehouse, whether covered by a WSAD or TSAD. For Customs Common Bonded Warehouses (CCBWs), reckoning of the storage period shall start from the arrival of the goods to the mother warehouse.

ai.title: Storage Period
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Maximum na isang (1) taon ang itatagal ng bonded goods sa CBW, bilang mula sa pagdating sa warehouse, WSAD man o TSAD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: One year ang 'deadline' ng goods sa loob ng CBW. Sa CCBW, nagsisimula ang bilang sa pagdating sa mother warehouse.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Pagkatapos ng storage period, puwedeng ituring na abandoned ang goods (Sec. 16).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Storage Period. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For perishable goods, the storage period shall be three (3) months from the date of arrival at the warehouse, extendible for valid reasons, and upon written request, for another three (3) months.

ai.title: Storage Period ng Perishables
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Tatlong (3) buwan lang ang storage period ng perishable goods, at puwedeng i-extend ng another three (3) months.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Mas maikli dahil mabilis masira ang perishables. May extension, pero kailangan ng valid reason at written request.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Hindi awtomatiko ang extension.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1 (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Storage Period ng Perishables. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Allowable Importations. Importations shall be made within the limits of the CBW's respective authority/license, as applied for and approved, to wit:

ai.title: Allowable Importations
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat nasa loob lang ng limits ng authority/license ng CBW ang importations, ayon sa inaprubahan.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng mag-import ng kahit ano. Ang nasa license lang, at tatlong limits ang nakalista sa a. hanggang c.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang approved na application ang basehan, hindi ang gusto ng operator.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.3 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Allowable Importations. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: The specific raw materials, according to their corresponding H.S. Tariff lines;

ai.title: Specific Raw Materials
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang raw materials na puwedeng i-import ay tinutukoy ayon sa H.S. Tariff lines.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dapat tugma ang imported materials sa tariff lines na nakalista sa license.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.3.a ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Specific Raw Materials. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: The volume/quantity of said raw materials, in the particular unit of measure (e.g. square meter, kilograms, liters) it is authorized to import; and

ai.title: Volume/Quantity Limit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May limit din sa dami ng raw materials, sa unit of measure na nakasaad sa license.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi lang kung anong materyales ang binabantayan, kundi pati kung gaano karami.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.3.b ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Volume/Quantity Limit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: In the case of Industry-Specific Customs Bonded Warehouses (ICBWs), the Client End-Users for whom said raw materials, identified according to their corresponding H.S. tariff lines, maybe transferred/sold; and the quantity/volumes, in the particular unit of measure (e.g. square meters, kilograms, liters) allowed per client.

ai.title: ICBW Client End-Users
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa ICBW, tinutukoy din kung sinong Client End-Users ang puwedeng bentahan ng raw materials at kung ilan ang allowed kada client.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May 'client list' at 'quota per client' ang ICBW bukod sa tariff lines at total volume.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.3.c ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa ICBW Client End-Users. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Goods not authorized for importation under warehousing or in excess of the volume and quantity allowed under the CBW's license shall be subject to payment of duties and taxes.

ai.title: Goods na Lampas sa License
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang goods na hindi awtorisado o lampas sa volume/quantity ng license ay kailangang bayaran ang duties and taxes.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi 'tax-free' ang sobra o ang hindi pasok sa license.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ito ang epekto ng paglabag sa Sec. 2.1.3 a. hanggang c.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1 (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Goods na Lampas sa License. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Non-importation of Finished Goods. Except when such goods are intended to be used as a component in the manufacture/production of another finished goods for export as approved by the Customs Bonded Warehouse Committee (CBWC), no importation of finished goods for warehousing shall be allowed.

ai.title: Non-importation of Finished Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bawal mag-import ng finished goods para sa warehousing, maliban kung gagamitin itong component sa paggawa ng ibang finished goods na ie-export at aprubado ng CBWC.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang CBW ay para sa raw materials na ipo-process, hindi para sa ready-made na produkto na ibebenta lang.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang CBWC ang nag-aapruba ng exception.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.4 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Non-importation of Finished Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Restricted and Regulated Goods. Restricted and regulated goods without the corresponding clearance and/or import authority duly issued by a competent authority shall be subject to seizure and forfeiture proceedings.

ai.title: Restricted and Regulated Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang restricted o regulated goods na walang clearance o import authority mula sa competent authority ay puwedeng i-seize at i-forfeit.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kahit bonded warehousing, kailangan pa rin ng permit kung regulated ang item.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang bonded status ay hindi exemption sa regulatory requirements.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.5 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Restricted and Regulated Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawals for Local Sales/Domestic Consumption. No withdrawals for domestic consumption shall be allowed, except upon approval by the District Collector, as recommended by the Operating Division and only upon payment of corresponding duties and taxes, provided such withdrawal for local sales/domestic sales shall not exceed thirty percent (30%) to the total volume of bonded raw materials transferred to the CBW for the year. The prohibition on the threshold limit for local sales shall not apply to Private Customs Bonded Warehouses (PCBWs).

ai.title: Local Sales / Domestic Consumption
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bawal ang withdrawal para sa domestic consumption, maliban kung aprubado ng District Collector (sa rekomendasyon ng Operating Division) at nabayaran ang duties and taxes. Hindi dapat lumampas sa 30% ng total volume ng bonded raw materials na inilipat sa CBW sa loob ng taon.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Puwedeng magbenta locally pero may cap na 30% kada taon, at kailangang bayaran ang buwis. Walang cap ang PCBW. Halimbawa: 100,000 kg na inilipat sa isang taon, hanggang 30,000 kg lang ang puwedeng local sales.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang 30% limit ay hindi umiiral sa PCBWs.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.6 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Local Sales / Domestic Consumption. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal for Sub-Contracting. A MCBW Operator or accredited member may, on account of insufficiency of operational facilities or lack of material time to meet export commitment, withdraw the bonded goods without payment of duty and/or tax and sub-contract the processing thereof, subject to the approval of the District Collector and the following guidelines:

ai.title: Withdrawal for Sub-Contracting
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Puwedeng mag-withdraw ang MCBW Operator o accredited member ng bonded goods nang walang bayad na duty/tax para i-subcontract ang processing, kung kulang ang facilities o oras para sa export commitment, basta aprubado ng District Collector.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Tulong ito para hindi malate ang export. May apat na guidelines sa a. hanggang d.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kailangan ang approval ng District Collector at accredited ang subcontractor.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.7 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Withdrawal for Sub-Contracting. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: Only duly accredited sub-contractors may undertake subcontracting jobs;

ai.title: Accredited Sub-contractors Lang
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Accredited sub-contractors lang ang puwedeng gumawa ng subcontracting jobs.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Dapat dumaan sa accreditation (Sec. 3.4.3).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.7.a ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Accredited Sub-contractors Lang. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: b.
paragraphs.text: The work to be undertaken by the sub-contractor shall, whenever practicable, be specified;

ai.title: Specified Work
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat tukuyin, hangga't practicable, ang trabahong gagawin ng sub-contractor.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Malinaw dapat kung ano ang ipoproseso para madaling ma-account ang materials.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.7.b ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Specified Work. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: c.
paragraphs.text: For garment manufacturer, transfer of materials required for manufacturing shall be subject to the rules and regulations and approval of the concerned government agency. Only pre-cut or cut-to-pattern materials shall be transferred, unless otherwise approved by the concerned government agency; and

ai.title: Garment Sub-contracting
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa garment manufacturer, sakop ng rules at approval ng concerned government agency ang transfer. Pre-cut o cut-to-pattern lang ang ililipat, maliban kung aprubado ng agency.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng ilipat ang tela in rolls nang basta-basta. Dapat pre-cut para madaling ma-track.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan din ang Sec. 11.3.6 tungkol sa fabrics in rolls.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.7.c ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Garment Sub-contracting. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: d.
paragraphs.text: Upon completion of the processing done by the subcontractor, finished materials and the resulting wastages, if any, shall be returned to the CBW or CCBW accredited member which shall be examined by the assigned Warehouseman to account for the duty and/or tax-free raw materials used in processing.

ai.title: Return ng Finished Materials at Wastages
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagkatapos ng processing, ibabalik sa CBW o CCBW accredited member ang finished materials at wastages, at i-e-examine ng assigned Warehouseman.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kailangang bumalik ang lahat ng lumabas na materyales (produkto at tira) para ma-account ang duty-free raw materials na nagamit.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan din ang Sec. 11.2 tungkol sa 30-day return period.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.7.d ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Return ng Finished Materials at Wastages. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Prohibition on Importations by Industry-Specific Customs Bonded Warehouses. Importation by ICBWs of fibers, yarns, fabrics and accessories for the manufacture of garments shall not be allowed.

ai.title: Prohibition sa ICBW Imports
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bawal sa ICBWs ang mag-import ng fibers, yarns, fabrics at accessories para sa paggawa ng garments.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng gawing 'pang-garment materials' na bodega ang ICBW. May hiwalay na Garment CBW (code 'G', Sec. 7).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.1.8 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Prohibition sa ICBW Imports. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Provisions Specific to Common Customs Bonded Warehouses and its Accredited Members.

ai.title: CCBW Provisions
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading ito para sa rules na para lang sa Common Customs Bonded Warehouses (CCBW) at accredited members nila.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang CCBW ay shared warehouse. May 'mother warehouse' (operator) at mga member na manufacturer-exporters.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa CCBW Provisions. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A manufacturer-exporter shall be accredited with only one CCBW which shall be known as the mother warehouse.

ai.title: One CCBW Lang
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Isang CCBW lang ang puwedeng pag-accreditan ng manufacturer-exporter, at tinatawag itong mother warehouse.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Bawal ang dual membership.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang paglipat sa ibang CCBW ay dumadaan sa transfer of membership (Sec. 3.4.2).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.2.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa One CCBW Lang. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The mother warehouse and its accredited members shall maintain at all times in their place of business and make available for inspection their books of accounts, supporting documents and records of imported materials and shall secure the materials imported through the CCBW against pilferage and loss due to fires, floods, and other such occurrences.

ai.title: Records at Security
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat laging available for inspection ang books of accounts, supporting documents at records ng imported materials, at protektado ang materyales laban sa nakawan, sunog, baha at iba pa.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Responsibilidad ng operator at members ang kumpletong dokumento at ligtas na bodega.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Tingnan ang Sec. 8.3.3 at 8.3.4.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 2.2.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Records at Security. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The warehouse/place of business of the mother warehouse and its accredited member shall be made accessible to all authorized Customs Officials or representatives upon presentation of an approved Mission Order issued by the District Collector or Commissioner of Customs.

ai.title: Access ng Customs Officials
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Dapat buksan sa authorized Customs Officials ang warehouse ng mother warehouse at members kapag may approved Mission Order mula sa District Collector o Commissioner.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng tanggihan ang inspeksyon kung may valid na Mission Order.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Mission Order ang susi. Walang Mission Order, walang basehan ang pagpasok.

paragraphs.text: Maintenance of Principal Books of Account. The Bureau and the CBW Operator shall keep and maintain Principal Books of Accounts containing the records of importation, exportation and liquidation, including wastages, of all goods delivered to and withdrawn from a CBW. The General Services Division of the Bureau shall design a uniform template for the books of accounts which shall then be officially issued to each CBW Operator for a fee. Importation data shall include, among others, Warehousing Entry Number, Date of Arrival, Date received at the CBW, Specific Description of Goods and Tariff Heading, Quantity/Volume/Weight, Duties and Taxes/amount of Bonds and Date of Expiry. Exportation data shall include, among others, Export Declaration Number, Date Exported, Description of Finished Goods and Product Code, Certificate of Identification (CI) Number, Certificate of Inspection and Loading (CIL), Transfer Note (Boatnote)/Transfer Note No. if applicable, and Bill of Lading (BL) No.

paragraphs.text: The COO III shall register the TSAD in the E2M system and shall accomplish the inspection act.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katulad ng Sec. 10.1.6.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.3 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Registration ng TSAD. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Prior to doing the final assessment, the COO V shall ensure that the shipment, if containerized, is booked in the E-TRACC system.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bago ang final assessment, titiyakin ng COO V na naka-book sa E-TRACC ang containerized shipment.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Parehong requirement sa WSAD.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.4 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa E-TRACC Booking sa TSAD. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The COO V shall perform the final assessment of the TSAD. This will trigger the automatic charging of the assessed duties and taxes to the bond's account for GTSB of the CBW Operator in the ABMS. The TSAD Assessment Notice is the notification that the assessed duties and taxes is charged against the GTSB.

ai.title: Final Assessment ng TSAD
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Gagawin ng COO V ang final assessment ng TSAD at awtomatikong sisingilin ang duties at taxes sa GTSB account ng CBW Operator sa ABMS. Ang TSAD Assessment Notice ang abiso na na-charge sa GTSB.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa transit, GTSB ang sumasalo ng buwis.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: GTSB sa TSAD, GWB sa WSAD.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.5 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Final Assessment ng TSAD. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Transfer of containerized goods from the port of discharge to the CBW shall follow the procedures outlined in CMO No. 04-2020 on the implementation of the E-TRACC System.

ai.title: E-TRACC sa Transit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Susundin ang procedures ng CMO No. 04-2020 sa containerized transfer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Kapareho ng Sec. 10.1.16.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.6 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa E-TRACC sa Transit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: If the shipment is loose cargo, the Operating Division concerned shall issue a Mission Order designating a customs guard to conduct under-guarding activity during the transfer of the shipment to the CBW. The assigned Customs Guard shall coordinate with the PID or AOD/equivalent unit for the issuance of the Transfer Note (Boatnote) to accompany the goods for transfer.

ai.title: Loose Cargo
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kung loose cargo, ang Operating Division ay mag-iisyu ng Mission Order para sa customs guard na magbabantay sa transfer at makikipag-coordinate sa PID o AOD para sa Transfer Note.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Katulad ng LCL sa Sec. 10.1.14.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.7 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Loose Cargo. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Upon arrival of the shipment at the CBW, the assigned Warehouseman assigned at the CBW shall, upon presentation of the Transfer Note (Boatnote) and copy of the TSAD, shall acknowledge receipt of goods by stamping "RECEIVED" at the copy of the approved TSAD and forward the same to the Deputy Collector for Operations at the port of destination for "TAG ARRIVE" at the system.

ai.title: RECEIVED at TAG ARRIVE
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Pagdating sa CBW, tatanggapin ng Warehouseman ang goods sa pagpapakita ng Transfer Note at kopya ng TSAD, tatatakan ng 'RECEIVED' ang TSAD, at ipapasa sa Deputy Collector for Operations sa port of destination para sa 'TAG ARRIVE' sa system.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang stamp na 'RECEIVED' ang patunay na dumating ang transit goods.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kailangan ang TAG ARRIVE para ma-close ang transit.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.8 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa RECEIVED at TAG ARRIVE. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The corresponding WSAD shall be filed within five (5) days from date of transfer of the goods to the CBW. The assigned Warehouseman shall ensure that no stripping of goods from the container van shall be done unless the Goods Declaration for Warehousing of the transited goods has been filed.

ai.title: WSAD Pagkatapos ng Transit
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang kaukulang WSAD ay ifa-file sa loob ng limang (5) araw mula transfer ng goods sa CBW. Titiyakin ng Warehouseman na walang stripping ng goods mula sa container van hangga't hindi pa nafa-file ang WSAD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 5 araw para mag-WSAD pagkatapos ng transit, at bawal munang i-strip ang container.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Bawal ang stripping hangga't walang WSAD.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.9 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa WSAD Pagkatapos ng Transit. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Said filing of the WSAD shall be required until such time that the Bureau shall have implemented the use of a multi-purpose declaration in its E2M system.

ai.title: Multi-purpose Declaration
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Kailangan ang pag-file ng WSAD hanggang ma-implement ng Bureau ang multi-purpose declaration sa E2M system.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Pansamantalang requirement lang ito.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2 (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Multi-purpose Declaration. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: In case of CCBWs, delivery of goods from the Port of Discharge shall be to the mother warehouse where the Customs seal under the E-TRACC system shall be disarmed.

ai.title: CCBW Delivery
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa CCBW, ang delivery mula Port of Discharge ay sa mother warehouse kung saan idi-disarm ang Customs seal sa ilalim ng E-TRACC.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Sa mother warehouse muna, hindi sa member.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 10.2.10 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa CCBW Delivery. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The CBW Operator shall, within the prescribed storage period, apply for withdrawal of the bonded goods either for production for export, transfer to accredited sub-contractor/member, sale, or transfer to another CBW, freezone registered locator/enterprise, Client End-User or Client-Exporter. CBW Operators shall ensure that the raw materials that were first transferred to, and stored in, the bonded warehouse, shall first be withdrawn for production. The same manner shall likewise be observed in the reconciliation of raw materials for adherence to the principle of first-in-first-out (FIFO) system.

ai.title: Withdrawal of Bonded Goods
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Sa loob ng storage period, mag-a-apply ang CBW Operator ng withdrawal para sa production for export, transfer sa accredited sub-contractor/member, sale, o transfer sa ibang CBW, freezone locator, Client End-User o Client-Exporter. Ang unang pumasok na raw materials ang unang ilalabas (FIFO), pati sa reconciliation.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: FIFO: first in, first out. Ang pinakamatandang stock ang uunahin.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang FIFO ay para sa withdrawal at sa reconciliation.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Section 11. Withdrawal of Bonded Goods (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Withdrawal of Bonded Goods. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal of Raw Materials for Production. Raw materials withdrawn from MCBWs for production shall be accompanied by a duly filled up Requisition Slip in accordance with the prescribed format in Annex "H" to be filed with the assigned Warehouseman of the concerned CBW. No transfer of the bonded goods to accredited members shall be made unless the required Requisition Slip has been filed.

ai.title: Withdrawal for Production
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang raw materials na ilalabas sa MCBW para sa production ay dapat may Requisition Slip (Annex 'H') na ifa-file sa Warehouseman. Walang transfer sa accredited members kung walang Requisition Slip.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Walang Requisition Slip, walang labas.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Ang paglabag dito ay ground para sa closure (Sec. 18.1.9).
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Withdrawal for Production. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The assigned Warehouseman shall check the documents, and if in order, approve and release the raw materials being requisitioned. A copy of the Requisition Slip shall be furnished the Operating Division concerned weekly for recording in the operator's logbook.

ai.title: Pag-release ng Warehouseman
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Titingnan ng Warehouseman ang dokumento at, kung maayos, aaprubahan at ire-release ang raw materials. Linggu-linggo, bibigyan ng kopya ng Requisition Slip ang Operating Division para i-record sa logbook ng operator.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Weekly na reporting ng Requisition Slips.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.1 (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Pag-release ng Warehouseman. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal of Goods for Transfer to Sub-Contractor. Raw materials withdrawn for transfer to sub-contractors for production must also be covered by a Requisition Slip to be filed with the assigned Warehouseman of the concerned CBW. The Warehousemen shall conduct an inventory and identification of the materials to be sub-contracted and accomplish the Withdrawal Form following the format in Annex "I" which shall contain the description of the materials to be transferred, the quantity and the Requisition Slip number(s). For recording purposes, the Account Officer shall be duly furnished with a copy of the Requisition Slip. Goods transferred to accredited subcontractors shall be returned to the CBW within thirty (30) days from date of transfer subject to extension upon prior request by the CBW Operator and approval of the District Collector. Transfers to accredited subcontractors shall be covered by a duly approved Authority to Transfer.

ai.title: Transfer to Sub-Contractor
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang raw materials para sa sub-contractor ay may Requisition Slip din. Gagawa ang Warehouseman ng inventory at Withdrawal Form (Annex 'I'). Ibabalik sa CBW ang goods sa loob ng 30 araw, extendible kapag may prior request at approval ng District Collector. May approved Authority to Transfer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 30 araw ang palugit ng subcontractor para ibalik ang finished goods at wastages.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Kailangan ng prior request para sa extension, hindi pagkatapos ng deadline.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Transfer to Sub-Contractor. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal of Bonded Raw Materials for Transfer from CCBW to Accredited Member.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading para sa paglipat ng raw materials mula CCBW papunta sa accredited member.

paragraphs.text: The operator shall prepare the Requisition Slip and file it with the assigned Warehouseman of the mother CCBW.

ai.title: Requisition Slip sa CCBW
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang operator ang gagawa ng Requisition Slip at ifa-file sa Warehouseman ng mother CCBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Unang hakbang ang Requisition Slip.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Requisition Slip sa CCBW. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The assigned Warehouseman shall check the documents, and if in order, shall conduct an inventory and identification of the materials to be transferred to the accredited member and accomplish the Withdrawal Form.

ai.title: Inventory at Withdrawal Form
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Titingnan ng Warehouseman ang dokumento at, kung maayos, gagawa ng inventory at identification ng materials at Withdrawal Form.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Verification bago ilabas.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Inventory at Withdrawal Form. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The transfer shall be under-guarded by the Customs Guard assigned thereat and covered by a Transfer Note (Boatnote) and receipt of the goods shall be acknowledged by the assigned Customs Storekeeper/assigned customs officer and the responsible officer of the accredited member.

ai.title: Under-guarded Transfer
ai.content:

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: May bantay at may pirmahan ng tumanggap.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.3 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Under-guarded Transfer. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: A copy of the Requisition Slip shall be furnished the Common Bonded Warehouse Division for recording in the logbook being kept by the Account Officer.

ai.title: Kopya sa Common Bonded Warehouse Division
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Bibigyan ng kopya ng Requisition Slip ang Common Bonded Warehouse Division para i-record sa logbook ng Account Officer.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Para sa records.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.4 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Kopya sa Common Bonded Warehouse Division. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The CCBW member shall prepare a Production Report of all goods transferred to its accredited members following the prescribed format in Annex "J" which shall be countersigned by the assigned Warehouseman to be submitted weekly to the assigned Account Officer.

ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Gagawa ang CCBW member ng Production Report ng lahat ng goods na inilipat (Annex 'J'), pipirmahan ng Warehouseman, at isusumite linggu-linggo sa Account Officer.

paragraphs.text: In the case of CCBWs involved in the manufacturing of garments, the fabrics imported by the CCBW Operator for the account of its accredited member must be cut-to-pattern or panel cut prior to the release therein to the accredited member.

ai.content:

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.6 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Garment Fabrics sa CCBW. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: However, transfers of fabrics in rolls from the CCBW Operator to its accredited members may be allowed for the following subject to validation by the assigned Warehouseman and subject to the approval of the Chief, CCBWD:

ai.title: Exception: Fabrics in Rolls
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Puwedeng payagan ang fabrics in rolls sa mga kaso sa a. hanggang e., basta validated ng Warehouseman at aprubado ng Chief, CCBWD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Exception sa pre-cut rule.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3 (unlabeled na talata) ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Exception: Fabrics in Rolls. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: For materials intended for printing/dyeing, washing, bias cutting and embroidery;

ai.title: Printing/Dyeing
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Para sa materials na ipi-print, ide-dye, huhugasan, bias cut at ie-embroider.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Hindi puwedeng i-cut muna ang tela kung ipi-print.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.a ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Printing/Dyeing. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.b ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Special Cutting Machines. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.c ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Mirror Matching. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.d ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Textured Fabrics. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: e.
paragraphs.text: For other reasons that are deemed justifiable by the Chief, CCBWD.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Discretion ng Chief.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.3.e ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Ibang Justifiable Reasons. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: Withdrawal for Sale of Semi-finished/Finished Products between Accredited Members Belonging to the same Customs Common Bonded Manufacturing Warehouse.

ai.title: Sale sa Pagitan ng Members
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Heading para sa bentahan ng semi-finished/finished products sa pagitan ng members ng iisang CCBW.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ito ay constructive export.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.4 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Sale sa Pagitan ng Members. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: An accredited member of a CCBW who intends to sell his semi-finished/finished products to another accredited member of the same CCBW shall inform the CCBW Operator who shall secure the approval of the District Collector by applying in writing for the issuance of an Authority to Sell, attaching thereto the duly filled up CI or BC Form 218 following the format in Annex "K" and the covering sales contract/purchase order or any other document specifying the following:

ai.title: Authority to Sell
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: Ang member na gustong magbenta ay magpapaalam sa CCBW Operator na kukuha ng approval ng District Collector sa pamamagitan ng nakasulat na aplikasyon para sa Authority to Sell, kalakip ang CI o BC Form 218 (Annex 'K') at sales contract/purchase order na nagsasabi ng a. at b.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang CCBW Operator ang nag-a-apply, hindi ang member.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Authority to Sell ang hinihingi.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.4.1 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Authority to Sell. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.4.1.a ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Description ng Products. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

ai.content:

ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.4.2 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Referral sa WAD. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.text: The Customs Examiner from the WAD/equivalent unit shall examine the bonded goods for sale/transfer and sign the CI (BC Form 218) which must reflect the following:

ai.title: Examination at CI
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: I-e-examine ng Customs Examiner ang goods at pipirmahan ang CI (BC Form 218) na may laman na nakalista sa a. hanggang k.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: Ang CI ang opisyal na dokumento ng sale.
ai.prompt: Ipaliwanag nang simple ang Sec. 11.4.3 ng CMO No. 03-2022 tungkol sa Examination at CI. Magbigay ng practical customs example, ipaliwanag kung bakit ito umiiral, banggitin ang related provisions, at linawin ang common misconceptions.

paragraphs.label: a.
paragraphs.text: WSAD number;

ai.title: WSAD Number
ai.content:

paragraphs.text: Period to Liquidate. The importer shall, within a non-extendible period of sixty (60) days from the date of complete and full exportation, submit the complete documents required for the liquidation of the WSAD. The same period shall likewise be given an importer for the submission of the complete documents required for the liquidation of the WSAD even in cases where complete exportation is made before the expiration of the prescribed storage period. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the maximum period within which to submit complete liquidation documents is thirty (30) days from the expiration of the storage period. Submission of documents after the thirty (30) day period shall be considered as late submission of documents and shall be subject to the penalties prescribed under Section 15 of Customs Administrative Order (CAO) No. 01-2022.

ai.title: Period to Liquidate
ai.content:
📖 Kahulugan: May non-extendible na 60 araw ang importer mula date ng complete at full exportation para isumite ang kumpletong liquidation documents. Pareho rin kung na-export na bago mag-expire ang storage period. Pero ang maximum ay 30 araw mula expiration ng storage period. Ang pagsumite pagkatapos ng 30 araw ay late submission at may penalty sa Sec. 15 ng CAO No. 01-2022.

💡 Simpleng Paliwanag: 60 araw mula full export, pero hindi lalampas ng 30 araw pagkatapos mag-expire ang storage period, alinman ang mas maaga. Halimbawa: kung nag-expire ang storage ng Hunyo 1, hanggang Hulyo 1 lang ang pagsumite.

⚠️ Dapat Tandaan: Non-extendible ang 60 araw. Late submission ang lampas.
